<script>
  const filterInput = document.getElementById('pub-filter');
  const publications = document.querySelectorAll('#publications-list .publication');
  const years = document.querySelectorAll('#publications-list .pub-year');

  function updateYearVisibility() {
    years.forEach(year => {
      let item = year.nextElementSibling;
      let hasVisiblePublication = false;
      while (item && !item.classList.contains('pub-year')) {
        if (item.classList.contains('publication') && item.style.display !== 'none') {
          hasVisiblePublication = true;
        }
        item = item.nextElementSibling;
      }
      year.style.display = hasVisiblePublication ? '' : 'none';
    });
  }

  filterInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const filter = filterInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    publications.forEach(pub => {
      const text = pub.textContent.toLowerCase();
      pub.style.display = text.includes(filter) ? '' : 'none';
    });
    updateYearVisibility();
  });
</script>
